schema.title: Response List Activities Api V1 Activities Get

patch.description:
Post-activity quick tags (surface, caffeine, jet lag…). `analyze=true` runs the agent
pipeline (first analysis after an upload); editing tags later never re-spends on its own:
the athlete asks for a new analysis explicitly (POST /analyze).

post.description:
Runs the agent pipeline. `background=true`: 202 now, poll GET /report (UI);
otherwise waits for the whole pipeline (debug).

get.description: Latest pipeline run for the activity (one entry per agent; missing = not run/failed).

post.description:
Starts the TrainingPeriodizationAgent in background. Poll GET /plans/{id} until
status is ACTIVE (or FAILED: see generation_error). The previous plan stays active
until the new one is complete.

get.description: Key-session changes waiting for the athlete's decision.

schema.title: Response List Proposals Api V1 Plans Active Proposals Get

post.description: Manual trigger of the weekly refinement (normally Sunday evening, automatic).

get.description:
Calendar of the active plan. Default: current week (Mon-Sun); with key_only=true the
default range is the whole plan ('where are my long runs').

schema.title: Response List Workouts Api V1 Workouts Get

get.description: Why and when a session changed (applied changes, proposals and their outcome).

post.description: Applies an adjustment proposed by the coach chat, after the athlete confirms it.

Deterministic 'Cadence vs HR Divergence' (stored in Activity.computed_metrics).

length collapses, while HR stays stable — muscular failure without cardiac drift.
